page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable review rules. Write one once, attach it to any agent.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill or import one from a markdown file or archive.

card.confirmDelete: Delete skill "{name}"? It is attached to {count, plural, =0 {no agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}.
card.vettingTitle: Imported from someone else — read it before enabling

trust.confirmEnable: "{name}" was imported from someone else. Once enabled, its text goes into the prompt of every agent it is attached to, as instructions the model follows. Enable it only if you have read it and trust it.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.nameHint: kebab-case. This is how the skill appears in prompts and run logs.
config.descriptionHint: The skill's interface: one directive sentence, e.g. "Flag…" or "Use when…". The model reads it before the body.
config.bodyHint: Markdown. Text only: a skill cannot run code, call tools or read files. Saving a changed body creates a new version.

create.title: Create a skill
create.subtitle: Text only: a name, a one-line directive and the rules in markdown.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag tests that cover only the happy path.
create.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule
Describe what to check and what to flag…

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Upload a SKILL.md / .md file or a .zip / .skill archive.
import.accepted: Accepts .md, .markdown, .zip and .skill, up to 2 MB. Archives are opened in your browser: scripts and binaries are never read, sent or run.

errors.too_large: The file is larger than 2 MB.
errors.bad_archive: This archive could not be opened.
errors.no_text: The archive contains no markdown or text files.
errors.server: Could not read a skill from this file: {message}

reason.not_text: executable or binary — not read, not run

import.trustTitle: You are adding someone else's instructions
import.trustBody: Once enabled, this text goes into the prompt of every agent it is attached to, and the model follows it like your own rules. It is saved disabled: read it, then enable it.
import.success: Imported "{name}". It stays disabled until you enable it.
